theorem_title: Constant-time lookup of a shared reporting record
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingLookup.program_meets {lim : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Limits} {μ : ℕ → ℤ} {fB fC : ℕ → ℤ}
    {free h J NB NC g s i j d : ℕ} {p shift : ℤ}
    (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankHeader.Stored μ free h J NB NC g fB fC p shift)
    (hs : s < _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceCatalog.count h J) (hi : i < _root_.ThreeSum.BandPartition.size NB g)
    (hj : j < _root_.ThreeSum.BandPartition.size NC g) (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hspace : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankHeader.finish free h J NB NC g ≤ lim.space) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingLookup.program 0 d [free,s,i,j] μ 500
      (fun result ν => result=(_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankAccess.recordAt free J NB NC g s i j : ℤ) ∧ ν=μ) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $\mu$ contain a shared reporting bank at address $a$ for parameters $h,J$, original band-array lengths $N_B,N_C$, band size $g$, maps $f_B,f_C:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, and integer modulus/offset $p,\delta$. Fix a valid occurrence index $s$ and valid B/C band indices $i,j$. If the bank's finish address fits the run's address space and addresses fit words, then for every call depth $d$ procedure zero on $(a,s,i,j)$ returns the exact shared-bank record address in at most

$$500\text{ steps},$$

leaving the entire memory unchanged.

This supplies actual bounded access to the reused source-pair catalogs in the deterministic integer 3SUM reporter.
